detached_structure.evidence: A smaller gray-roofed building sits behind the central house, toward the upper center of the tile. It appears separate from the main house, but it may belong to the adjacent lot.

signals.notes: The central house has a gray roof with some weathering. The lawn is dry and brown, a walkway leads to the street, and the yard behind the house is cluttered and overgrown, with a possible rear outbuilding.
